newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Oct manufacture input prices rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Oct manufacture input prices rise.

text.p: The prices of materials used in Australian manufacturing rose 0.7 percent in October from the previous month and stood 2.6 percent lower than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
"Price increases for locally produced and imported crude oil were the main contributors to the increase in the index," the bureau said.
"The overall increase was partly offset by price falls for sheep and wheat and for imported chemicals," it said.
On a monthly basis, this was the first rise in manufacturing input prices since January when they rose 1.4 percent, although there was a flat result in April.
